events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her influence on rock music is undeniable. Which Pretenders track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for It
angles.copy: You know the voice, you know the attitude! Liam Gallagher is 54 today. What's your favourite lyric from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (UK Single)
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-one years since its UK single release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' still resonates. A timeless message of peace and unity. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember life before? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed everything for music lovers. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film, and who's the ultimate Bond for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your go-to Lennon track?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's a true comedic icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Fifty-Eight Years of White
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that pushed boundaries. Which track from it still blows you away?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are forever etched in rock history. What's your favourite Queen performance?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that marked a new direction. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was 40 years old.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we reflect on the immense loss of John Lennon. His music and message of peace remain as vital as ever. Share your favourite memory or song.
